g.title: ABBA2SharedFullExecution
g.text: ABBA2 | Complete execution through the common integration lifecycle
Horizontal: complete lifecycle. Vertical: shared services and the selected method recipe.
COMMON / FAMILY: blue services and green numerical kernels. METHOD SPECIFIC: orange step recipe.
Implemented runtime: public contracts and numerical maps are retained. N = particles; T = saved times; m = 2N.
Module paths are relative to src/simulation/methods/abba/ unless stated otherwise.

g.title: Prepare
g.text: new_run creates an instance of the concrete order.
Validate state/energy capabilities and solver options.

The class owns solve_step, advance and export.
Physical: planar dynamics and selected derivatives.

g.title: RunMethod
g.text: SAME NUMERICAL CLASS / ONE INSTANCE PER EXECUTION
No separate context or callback-based method record.
Construct another instance for another integration.
Completed runs cannot re-enter the global driver.
The collector and external observer own histories.

g.title: StatePolicy
g.text: Physical + energy: (z, kappa), kappa in R^N.
Fully extended: (x, y, t, k) in R^4.
Finish from the last accepted projection state.
Physical tracking uses the accepted stage traces,
including their signed durations and start times.
Auxiliary kappa never feeds back into z.
Full extension evolves t,k and synchronizes time.

g.title: Runtime
g.text: Create a fresh controller and IntegrationCollector.
Validate each accepted interval and state.
save requested samples; report temporal progress.

g.title: Grid
g.text: Yield StepInfo and run.advance(t, state, h).
Interior output: shortened advance from a copy
A shadow sample does not alter the main grid.
Its work is excluded from metrics and observations.

g.title: Advance
g.text: INHERITED ABBA ADVANCE / NO TIME LOOP
step_statistics(...) extracts one small metric row.
Return that row and the family result as details.
No accumulation or observer callback occurs here.
Main and shadow calls use the same advance.

g.title: StepResult
g.text: One common contract for both methods.
ABBA4 returns one outer projection record.
step_statistics and event builders read projections.
Accepted numerical traces live in those records.

g.title: StepRecipe
g.text: ABBA2 STEP RECIPE / SHARED FAMILY CONTRACT
Bind one base map for duration h.
Call the shared projection formulation once.
One A-B-B-A map and one nonlinear solve.
The shared runtime handles the rest of the run.

g.text: The selected map may be one A-B-B-A map

in R^(6N) or R^12; map defects + diagonal equality.

g.title: Legend
g.text: Thick arrows between phase headers: overall lifecycle; phases 04 and 05 repeat together for each main step.
Thin solid arrows: calls or required data. Dotted blue arrows: returned values. Dashed purple arrows: optional events.
A hollow diamond means a record contains another record. Red dashed arrows indicate failure propagation.
Blue and green SHARED cards denote the same components in both diagrams; orange cards define the model step.
IntegrationMethod, integrate_method, FixedStepController and IntegrationCollector are shared by all numerical methods.
_ABBAImplicitMethod, StatePolicy, projection kernels and numerical traces remain ABBA family components.
The generic StepResult holds state, statistics and opaque method details; ABBA details hold projection records. Each record retains a single-map or composed-map trace.
ABBA2: one projected map. ABBA4: one projection around three unprojected maps.
Projection placement remains part of the numerical method. Physical and extended equations keep their specialized algebra.
Physical auxiliary energy does not change z. Sampling and observation preserve main trajectories and solve statistics.

g.title: Recording
g.text: ONE RUN / REQUESTED SAMPLES + ACCEPTED METRICS
Copy metric rows with stable keys and shapes.
Never store method details or observer events.
Rejected adaptive trials have no accepted row;
their numerical work belongs to the accepted step.

g.title: EventBuilder
g.text: Unpack info.state_before into the event domain.
Copy accepted traces and method-specific snapshots.
Compute tangents only if the event requires them.
The event retains map_state and numerical timing.
Analysis and persistence remain in diagnostics/.
Shadow samples never request this builder.

g.text: Finalize, validate and interpret the trajectory

g.title: Data
g.text: extracts the physical state and optional energy.
Export never repeats the numerical projection.
Internal and physical dimensions may differ.
Return to the original SimulationRunner call.
Only the requested trajectory is exposed by default.

g.title: Events
g.text: One projected physical map and stage snapshots.
Physical energy tracking retains this event type.
One projected full-state map and one base record.
Builders adapt the same StepResult contract.
Preserve times, states, map_state and tangents.

g.text: Stop the run; do not construct a successful
Retain method, time and solve context.

g.title: MetricRow
g.text: Select residual AND tolerance from the same solve
Take the maximum multiplier infinity norm.
ABBA2: one; ABBA4: one; ABBA6: seven.
The common collector stacks accepted rows.

g.title: Resume
g.text: Require exactly the requested output times.
Check shape, finiteness and packed layout.
Verify that the initial state is preserved.
